ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Attach the triaxial accelerometer to the spindle nose with sensor axes aligned to machine X, Y, and Z. Run at 3000 RPM with no toolholder and record RMS vibration velocity in each axis. Repeat at maximum rated speed and compare all six readings against the baseline from previous service.

ground_truth.node_text: Attach a triaxial accelerometer to the spindle nose using a flat washer stud or epoxy mount with the sensor axes aligned to the machine X, Y, and Z axes. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder and record the root mean square vibration velocity in each axis. Repeat the measurement at the maximum rated speed and compare all six readings against the baseline vibration record from the previous service.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Accelerometer mounted and measurements taken at both speeds. All six readings recorded and compared to baseline.

ground_truth.node_text: Attach a triaxial accelerometer to the spindle nose using a flat washer stud or epoxy mount with the sensor axes aligned to the machine X, Y, and Z axes. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder and record the root mean square vibration velocity in each axis. Repeat the measurement at the maximum rated speed and compare all six readings against the baseline vibration record from the previous service.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the vibration level below the alarm threshold at warm up speed?

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration level below alarm threshold at warm up speed?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, vibration readings are within acceptable limits at warm up speed.

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration level below alarm threshold at warm up speed?

turns.utterance: Is the front bearing temperature within the rated limit after warm up?

ground_truth.node_text: Front bearing temperature within rated limit after warm up?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Confirmed, the front bearing temperature is within the rated limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Front bearing temperature within rated limit after warm up?

turns.utterance: Is the radial runout within 1 micrometer at the spindle nose?

turns.utterance: No, the total indicator reading shows runout exceeding 1 micrometer.

ground_truth.node_text: Radial runout within 1 µm at spindle nose?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the front bearing preload in quarter turn increments on the locknut.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust front bearing pre load, locknut quarter turn increments

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the radial runout after the bearing preload adjustment.

turns.utterance: Runout is now within specification after the adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after bearing pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the axial play within the 2 micrometer limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Axial play within 2 µm limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the mean deflection reading exceeds 2 micrometers.

ground_truth.node_text: Axial play within 2 µm limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the preload shim stack by adding or removing shims as required.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust pre load shim stack, add or remove shims as required

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Shim stack adjusted to correct the axial play.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust pre load shim stack, add or remove shims as required

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Apply Prussian blue to a clean test arbor, insert it into the spindle taper bore, and rotate by hand under moderate axial load for two to three turns. Withdraw and inspect the transfer pattern for uniform contact over at least 75% of the taper length.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply a thin uniform coat of Prussian blue or engineer's marking compound to the taper surface of a clean test arbor. Insert the arbor into the spindle taper bore and rotate by hand under moderate axial load for two to three turns. Withdraw the arbor and inspect the transfer pattern; uniform contact over at least 75% of the taper length is required. A patchy or one sided pattern indicates taper bore damage, swarf contamination, or arbor misalignment.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Test arbor inserted and rotated. Transfer pattern inspected after withdrawal.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply a thin uniform coat of Prussian blue or engineer's marking compound to the taper surface of a clean test arbor. Insert the arbor into the spindle taper bore and rotate by hand under moderate axial load for two to three turns. Withdraw the arbor and inspect the transfer pattern; uniform contact over at least 75% of the taper length is required. A patchy or one sided pattern indicates taper bore damage, swarf contamination, or arbor misalignment.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the taper contact pattern above 80% of the taper area?

ground_truth.node_text: Taper contact pattern above 80% of taper area?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the contact pattern shows uniform coverage over more than 80% of the taper area.

ground_truth.node_text: Taper contact pattern above 80% of taper area?

turns.utterance: Is the drawbar retention force within the rated range?

turns.utterance: No, the peak force reading is below the minimum specified retention force.

ground_truth.node_text: Drawbar retention force within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Replace the disc spring stack and recheck the retention force.

turns.utterance: Disc spring stack replaced and retention force rechecked.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Using a calibrated non-contact tachometer, direct the sensor beam at the reflective strip on the spindle nose. Command each of the four test speeds and record the actual speed displayed. Calculate the percentage speed error at each commanded speed.

ground_truth.node_text: Using a calibrated non contact tachometer, direct the sensor beam at a reflective strip on the spindle nose. Command each of the four test speeds from the machine controller and record the actual speed displayed by the tachometer. Calculate the percentage speed error at each commanded speed and compare against the maximum speed accuracy tolerance in the spindle acceptance specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Tachometer measurements completed at all four test speeds. Speed errors calculated and recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Using a calibrated non contact tachometer, direct the sensor beam at a reflective strip on the spindle nose. Command each of the four test speeds from the machine controller and record the actual speed displayed by the tachometer. Calculate the percentage speed error at each commanded speed and compare against the maximum speed accuracy tolerance in the spindle acceptance specification.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the speed accuracy within plus or minus 0.1% at all four test speeds?

turns.utterance: Yes, all four test speeds are within the 0.1% tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Speed accuracy within ±0.1% at all four test speeds?

turns.utterance: Yes, the RMS vibration velocity in all three axes is within the warning limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration within warning limit at full rated speed?

turns.utterance: No, the total thermal displacement at stabilization exceeds the 3 micrometer tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal growth within compensation model ±3 µm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Access the thermal growth model parameter screen in the machine controller. Read the current growth coefficient and reference temperature for the Z axis, then compare the stored values against the reference values from the last calibration.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Access the thermal growth model parameter screen in the machine controller. 2. Read the current growth coefficient and reference temperature for the Z axis. 3. Compare the stored values against the reference values from the last calibration.

turns.utterance: Thermal model parameters accessed and compared to last calibration values.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Access the thermal growth model parameter screen in the machine controller. 2. Read the current growth coefficient and reference temperature for the Z axis. 3. Compare the stored values against the reference values from the last calibration.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Command the spindle orientation to the zero degree reference position. Mount a precision angular encoder or dial test indicator on an arm at a known radius and measure the angular error. Command orientation to 90, 180, and 270 degrees and measure the angular error at each position.

ground_truth.node_text: Command the spindle orientation to the 0 degree reference position from the machine control panel. Mount a precision angular encoder or a dial test indicator on an arm at a known radius and measure the angular error relative to the reference mark. Command orientation to 90, 180, and 270 degrees and measure the angular error at each position; compare all four readings against the spindle orientation accuracy specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Spindle orientation tested at all four positions. Angular errors measured and recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Command the spindle orientation to the 0 degree reference position from the machine control panel. Mount a precision angular encoder or a dial test indicator on an arm at a known radius and measure the angular error relative to the reference mark. Command orientation to 90, 180, and 270 degrees and measure the angular error at each position; compare all four readings against the spindle orientation accuracy specification.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the spindle orientation within plus or minus 0.001 degrees of the commanded angle?

ground_truth.node_text: Spindle orientation within ±0.001° of commanded angle?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all four orientation positions are within the 0.001 degree tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Spindle orientation within ±0.001° of commanded angle?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the coolant flow and pressure at the spindle taper within specification?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant flow and pressure at spindle taper within specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the pressure gauge reading and flow indicator both show values within specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant flow and pressure at spindle taper within specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the test piece geometry within drawing tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Test piece geometry within drawing tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all bore diameter and face flatness measurements are within the specified tolerances.

ground_truth.node_text: Test piece geometry within drawing tolerance?

turns.utterance: Log all spindle measurements and update the maintenance record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all spindle measurements and update maintenance record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All measurements logged and maintenance record updated.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all spindle measurements and update maintenance record

turns.utterance: Procedure complete. Return the spindle to production status.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.utterance: Understood, spindle is ready for production.
